title: Doomsday Clock setting, seconds to midnight (lower = more dangerous)
notes: The Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists (founded by Manhattan Project scientists) has set the Doomsday Clock every year since 1947. Lower seconds-to-midnight means the Bulletin judges humanity closer to catastrophe. 1947: 7 minutes (420s). 1991 (post-Cold War): 17 minutes (1020s), the furthest from midnight it has ever been set. 2025: 89 seconds, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, climate change, biological threats, and disruptive technology including AI.
